name: icx-mcp
title: Calera Infinite Context (ICX) — Persistent Memory
description: Persistent epistemic memory and sub-5ms associative recall on the Volumetric Lattice Network for AI agents and LLMs with zero context decay.

tools.name: icx_remember
tools.description: Crystallizes text, code, or structured knowledge into the persistent Volumetric Memory lattice. Ingests sentences into permanent topological simplicial nodes without context window token decay.

tools.name: icx_recall_scoped
tools.description: Recalls exact grounded facts from the Volumetric Memory lattice matching a natural query. Returns zero-hallucination factual sentences, register slots, and document citations without attention diffusion.

tools.name: icx_search_facts
tools.description: Searches simplicial lattice nodes and decoded facts by query keywords and manifold proximity.

tools.name: icx_quote_slot
tools.description: Performs deterministic zero-LLM verbatim quote retrieval for a specific document family and ordinal slot index.

tools.name: icx_inspect_space
tools.description: Inspects active memory space telemetry: total crystallized simplicial nodes, synapses, decoded facts, and contradiction alarms.

tools.name: icx_reset_session
tools.description: Resets active conversation dialogue history while strictly preserving all underlying crystallized knowledge and simplicial nodes.
